ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION

Star Union Dai-ichi Life Insurance (SUD Life) is a joint venture formed in 2007 between two major Indian PSU banks - Bank of India and Union Bank of India - and Japan's Dai-ichi Life Holdings.

We have served over 15 million customers through more than 19,500 bank branches across India. Our network includes 1,950 rural bank branches, ensuring insurance reaches remote areas.

SUD Life focuses on creating insurance products that meet different customer needs across all segments of society. With our promoters' 100+ years of commitment and combined strengths, we aim to become a leading name in India's life insurance sector while delivering value to all stakeholders.

Established in 1902, Dai-ichi Life is the second largest life insurance company of Japan and is one of the top ten life insurers globally, renowned for sound product knowledge, superior asset management skills, and solid operational capabilities to manage life insurance businesses.

At SUD Life, our customers are our priority. We are committed to providing insurance products that serve our customers unique needs across various strata of society and geographies.

The promoters of SUD Life have a long-term commitment towards their customers and stakeholder. These strengths and values have been inherited by SUD Life, as we make our way to becoming the next rising star in the Indian life insurance business, promising exceptional value to all.

To know more about us please visit:

Our Website: https://www.sudlife.in/

Our LinkedIn Page: https://www.linkedin.com/company/hidden_mobile2

Our Talent Philosophy

At Star Union Dai-ichi Life Insurance, we will ensure to nurture our people and provide opportunities to learn, succeed and build careers to the best of their abilities, thus creating and unlocking value for self, the organization, and the society at large.

d5f2208e114772eb.description: Introduction: We at Entiovi Technologies provide digital transformation using new-age intelligent technologies for more than 9 years. We have clients located primarily in the US and Europe that are served by our Dedicated teams. This job is part of our expansion in India. Location: Remote About the role The Senior Data Engineer in our AI & Data team will be responsible for designing and building the data structures and pipelines our AI Engineers rely on across Azure , Snowflake , Databricks , and Lakebase (our managed Postgres / OLTP layer). The primary mission of this role is to enable the AI Engineering team translating the needs of machine-learning and computer-vision workflows into reliable, well-modelled, and cost-effective data foundations. Tasks include setting up new data pipelines and transformations, ingesting structured and unstructured data into the data lake and warehouse, monitoring the performance and cost-effectiveness of existing data jobs, and docking machine-learning processes into the existing data landscape. The Data Engineer works hand in hand with AI Engineers and is the go-to person for making trusted data available for models, products, and analytics. Main Responsibilities As part of the AI & Data team, design and build the data structures, schemas, and models that AI Engineers depend on for training, feature engineering, and inference. Strong experience in Data Architecture. Strong knowledge of Git repositories. Develop and orchestrate scalable data pipelines on Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake) and load curated, analytics-ready data into Snowflake . Own data ingestion, transformation (ELT/ETL), and storage across the Azure cloud (e.G. ADLS, Data Factory, Event Hubs / Synapse), including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data such as text, images, and video. Dock machine-learning and computer-vision models into the data pipelines and design the data flow that feeds and consumes those AI services. Sync curated lakehouse data into Lakebase (managed Postgres) for low-latency serving, manage change-data-capture back into Delta tables, and support online feature stores and agent state for AI Engineers. Strong API knowledge and experience. Build and maintain API integrations and automated data ingestion from internal systems and external third-party sources. Monitor pipeline performance, reliability, and cost; troubleshoot failed jobs and optimize Snowflake and Databricks workloads. Implement data quality, validation, and lineage, and document the data dictionary and ETL processes. Partner with AI Engineers and stakeholders to translate model and business requirements into extensions of the data platform. Skills, Qualifications & Education Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field. At least 4 years of work experience in data engineering or a similar data-focused role. Hands-on production experience with Databricks (Apache Spark, Delta Lake, notebooks, workflows). Hands-on production experience with Snowflake (data modelling, performance tuning, access control, cost management). Solid experience with Microsoft Azure data services (e.G. ADLS, Data Factory, Event Hubs / Synapse). Experience with PostgreSQL and OLTP databases; familiarity with Lakebase (Databricks-managed Postgres) is a strong plus. Working knowledge of JavaScript / TypeScript , used for data APIs, microservices, or app-facing integrations. Strong expertise in SQL (will be tested during the recruitment process). Robust Python literacy, especially for data handling and pipeline development. Comfortable working with both structured and unstructured data; does not shy away from troubleshooting failed ETL processes or API integrations. Outstanding data-structure and data-modelling design skills. Working knowledge of machine-learning, NLP, or computer-vision workflows is a plus. Experience with dbt, Airflow, or Databricks Workflows, and with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code, is a plus. Strong ability to translate ideas between technical and non-technical audiences. Curious, collaborative, self-motivated, and organized; able to run multiple projects against tight deadlines. .

What you'll do
• 
Own the frontend architecture for complex, high-scale applications.
• 
Solve challenging problems around real-time interactions, streaming data, asynchronous workflows, and continuously changing UI state.
• 
Build reliable experiences around AI-generated responses, long-running tasks, tool calls, and partial results.
• 
Design systems that remain responsive and reliable when dealing with large amounts of data and long-running operations.
• 
Work closely with backend, product, and design teams to solve problems end to end.
• 
Identify architectural bottlenecks before they become scaling problems and drive the right long-term solutions.

Improve frontend performance across loading, rendering, network usage, memory, and bundle size.

Improve observability and production debugging through metrics, logging, error tracking, traces, and monitoring.
• 
Own complex production issues, identify root causes, and make sure the same problems don't keep coming back.
• 
Establish better approaches to testing, releases, feature flags, CI/CD, and frontend reliability.
• 
Lead architecture discussions and technical decisions across teams.
• 
Mentor engineers and help raise the overall frontend engineering bar.
• 
Take ambiguous problems from problem definition → design → implementation → production.

• 
8+ years of software engineering experience, with strong hands-on frontend experience.
• 
Deep experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Next.js.
• 
Strong understanding of frontend architecture, browser fundamentals, networking, rendering, and the web platform.
• 
Experience designing and scaling large production frontend applications.
• 
Strong understanding of state management, APIs, caching, authentication, and asynchronous systems.
• 
Experience building real-time or streaming experiences using technologies such as WebSockets, SSE, or streaming APIs.
• 
Strong understanding of web performance and experience solving real production performance problems.
• 
Experience with frontend observability and debugging production issues.
• 
Experience building shared components, design systems, or frontend platforms.
• 
Strong system-design skills and the ability to make practical architectural trade-offs.
• 
Ability to influence technical decisions across teams without relying on formal authority.
• 
Strong ownership and a bias toward solving problems at their root.
• 
Understanding of video and audio fundamentals, including media processing, encoding/decoding, formats, streaming, synchronization, and handling media workflows at scale.
• 
Experience building frontend experiences for video/audio processing or dubbing workflows is highly valuable.

Understanding of document digitization workflows, including document upload, processing states, previews, extraction results, editing/review experiences, and handling large or complex documents.

Experience building frontend applications that deal with large files, long-running processing jobs, progress tracking, retries, failures, and partial results.

Senior Equity Research Analyst
Location: Mumbai
Experience: 8+ Years
Industry: Financial Services / Capital Markets
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Equity Research Analyst to join the research team of a leading Capital Markets / Financial Services firm in Mumbai.
The role will focus on fundamental equity research, coverage of listed companies, financial modelling, valuation and generating independent investment recommendations. The candidate should have a strong track record of developing differentiated research views, setting target prices and publishing actionable research.
Key Responsibilities
• Conduct detailed fundamental research on listed companies across assigned sectors.
• Independently analyze companies, industries, business models, financial performance and growth prospects.
• Build and maintain financial models, earnings estimates and valuation models.
• Initiate and maintain coverage on companies and develop clear investment theses.
• Generate Buy / Hold / Sell recommendations and set target prices.
• Publish initiation reports, result updates, company reports, sector reports and thematic research reports.
• Track quarterly results, investor presentations, management commentary, corporate announcements and industry developments.
• Evaluate business drivers, earnings growth, valuation, management quality, competitive positioning and key investment risks.
• Conduct peer comparison and relative valuation analysis.
• Regularly revise earnings estimates, target prices and recommendations based on changing fundamentals.
• Participate in management meetings, analyst meets, investor conferences and earnings calls.
• Develop differentiated investment views and identify potential investment opportunities and catalysts.
• Interact with institutional investors, fund managers and sales teams to discuss research views and investment ideas.
• Provide timely research updates and actionable insights to clients.

Candidate Profile
• 8+ years of experience in Equity Research.
• Strong experience in Sell-Side / Institutional Equity Research.
• Proven experience covering listed companies and independently generating investment views.
• Strong track record of stock recommendations, target price setting and Buy / Hold / Sell calls.
• Strong institutional votes / research rankings are highly preferred.
• Candidates with established credibility and recognition among institutional investors will be preferred.
• Strong understanding of financial statements, business analysis, valuation and financial modelling.
• Ability to independently build and defend an investment thesis.
• Strong research writing and communication skills.
• Experience interacting with institutional investors, fund managers and company management.
• CFA / CA / MBA (Finance) or equivalent qualification would be preferred.

Preferred Background
Sell-Side Equity Research | Institutional Equity Research | Brokerage Firms | Capital Markets Firms

Ideal Candidate
We are specifically looking for candidates who have a demonstrated track record of publishing research, generating actionable stock calls and building strong institutional investor relationships.
Candidates with strong institutional votes / brokerage research rankings will be given preference.

d5f18777ca4a6c10.description: Optimo Capital is an RBI-registered NBFC focused on secured MSME lending, primarily through Loan Against Property (LAP). We serve small businesses that are underserved by traditional banks, and we do it with a lean, technology-first operating model.What makes us different is how close our product function sits to the actual business. We don't build software in a vacuum  we build tools directly out of the operational problems our credit, sales, collections, and ops teams run into every day. Our stack spans the full lending lifecycle: loan origination and servicing (LOS/LMS), a telecalling CRM, a communications orchestration platform, document management, bureau and data pipelines, and integrations with co-lending and channel partners.If you like the idea of shipping products that a real team uses the next morning, this is the environment for it.The RoleWe're looking for an Associate Product Manager to help us build and improve the internal and partner-facing products that power our lending operations. You'll own features and workflows end to end  from understanding the problem, to writing the spec, to coordinating the build, to rolling it out and measuring whether it actually worked.This is a hands-on, high-ownership role suited to someone early in their product career who wants to learn the craft by doing, inside a business where the feedback loop is short and the impact is visible.What You'll DoSit with the people who use our tools  telecallers, credit officers, ops, collections, sales  and turn their pain points into clear, well-scoped product requirements.Write crisp PRDs, user stories, and workflow specs that engineering and vendor partners can build from without guesswork.Coordinate delivery across in-house engineering and external technology vendors (e.g., our LOS/LMS provider), keeping timelines, dependencies, and priorities in order.Own UAT and rollout: test what gets built, catch the gaps before users do, write the documentation, and make sure adoption actually happens.Use data to inform and defend decisions  pull from dashboards and databases, look at funnel and operational metrics, and measure the impact of what you ship.Support integrations with co-lending partners and sourcing channels (DSAs) as our partnership footprint grows.Keep a pulse on the regulatory and operational context of lending so the products you build are compliant and practical, not just clever.What We're Looking For13 years of experience in product, business/data analytics, operations, consulting, or an early-stage/founder background  or a strong track record of building things.Structured thinking and clear writing. You can break an ambiguous problem into parts and explain your reasoning simply.Comfort with data. You're not intimidated by spreadsheets or a database, and you'd rather check a number than guess.Genuine curiosity about how lending, fintech, and financial services work.High agency. You chase down answers, follow through without being managed, and care about the outcome, not just the ticket.Strong communication and the ability to work across teams that don't naturally speak the same language (business, engineering, credit, compliance).Nice to HaveExposure to fintech, NBFCs, banking, or lending operations.Working knowledge of SQL, or comfort with no-code/low-code tools (Retool, Airtable, and the like).Some ability to build  a bit of coding, scripting, or prototyping goes a long way here.Familiarity with the Indian lending stack (LOS/LMS, CRM, WhatsApp Business API, bureau data).Why JoinReal ownership from day one  you'll ship products, not slides.A short path from idea to impact, with users you can actually talk to.Deep exposure to how a modern NBFC works across credit, operations, technology, and partnerships.The chance to learn product management the way it's meant to be learned: close to the operator, close to the problem.How to ApplySend your CV and a short note on something you've built or shipped  a product, a tool, a process, anything  to [insert application email / link]. Location - Bangalore            
                                                                                                
About the Team : The Platform Product team at Meesho is the backbone of our product ecosystem, empowering functions across product, business, analytics, tech, and data science. By building scalable platforms and tools, we enable teams to make data-driven decisions, accelerate development cycles, and enhance productivity. Our key focus areas include Data Acquisition, Analytics Tools, Experimentation, Segmentation, Payouts,  Security, Reporting and so on, which support critical functions of Meesho
 
 
About the Role : As a Platform Product Manager, you will own and drive one or more product charters within the Platform Product charter. Your role will be pivotal in enabling Meesho’s growth by ensuring seamless cross-functional collaboration and delivering impactful technical solutions. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, analysts, and data scientists across the organisation to turn complex ideas into actionable products.We’re looking for strategic thinkers passionate about building platforms that solve large-scale challenges. We want to hear from you if you are a self-starter, excel in driving initiatives independently, and thrive in dynamic environments.


What you will do
• Drive Product Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for one or more platform charters, aligning with business goals and maximizing value for internal stakeholders.

• Enable Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, product, analytics, and business teams to ensure alignment, remove blockers, and drive initiatives to completion.

• Optimise Platform Efficiency: Establish workflows, tools, and frameworks that reduce onboarding friction, accelerate product delivery, and improve time-to-market.

• Measure and Monitor Impact: Implement relevant metrics to evaluate the success of platform initiatives, ensuring data-driven decision-making at every stage.

• Risk Management: Anticipate risks, identify mitigation plans, and manage scope changes effectively to ensure on-time and high-quality releases.

• Communicate and Influence: Provide clear updates to senior management on progress, challenges, and key decisions. Based on data, develop executive-level insights and recommendations.

• Continuously Improve: Establish feedback loops to capture stakeholder insights, iterating on platform solutions to meet evolving business needs.

What you will need
• 3+ years of experience in product management, preferably in platform, data, or technical products.

• Proven track record of driving complex technical projects and delivering impactful results.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in data-driven decision-making.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to navigate cross-functional environments.

• Strong communication and presentation abilities, with experience in engaging with senior leadership.

• Technical understanding of data infrastructure, APIs, cloud platforms, or experimentation frameworks is a plus.
